page.overview:
Who is Alan Scott?

Alan Scott was one of the many ring bearers that Kyle Rayner remembered. Psycho-Pirate imagined himself fighting Alan and other members of the Justice Society. Later on, Alan was a reserve member of the Justice League, and helped fight Shadow Thief in Central City.
